text:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Require precision evidence in the claim gate**

When the tier is `real_pr_measured`, a matched control exists, and the denominator is nonzero, this normative row permits a comparative recall claim without checking precision evidence. That contradicts the business rule at lines 570–575 that precision evidence is mandatory for every recall claim, so an implementation following the matrix could publish recall conclusions despite having no false-positive comparison. Add the required precision evidence and regression result to this gate's inputs and admissible outcomes.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
